title: Recursion
definition: Recursion is a programming technique where a function calls itself to solve a smaller subproblem.
intuition: Solve a large problem by solving smaller instances of the exact same problem.
how_it_works: Requires a base case to terminate execution, and a recursive step to progress toward the base case.
when_to_use: For tree/graph traversals, divide-and-conquer, and backtracking.
when_not_to_use: When performance is critical and call stack overhead is too high.
complexity: Call Stack space: O(depth of recursion)
content: Recursion is a programming technique where a function calls itself to solve a smaller subproblem.
